project.description:
Machine-seeded glosses - the corpus tail, one definition per monophonic (character, reading), generated from Unihan and NOT YET CHECKED BY ANYBODY.
PROVENANCE: seeded from the Unicode Han Database (Unihan), (c) Unicode, Inc., under the Unicode Terms of Use, which permit redistribution.
SEPARATE FROM kranji-gloss ON PURPOSE. That module is written for the project and reviewed against the articles that use it; this one is a machine's first guess at 7,121 characters. The boundary is what makes "how much of this build has a person read?" a question the dependency graph answers rather than one somebody has to remember. It also means a build can drop the seed entirely - the reader degrades to no gloss, which it already handles - and that dropping it is one line.
Depends on kranji-core alone, never on kranji-gloss. A seed that could not be shipped without the hand-crafted set would not be separate in the way that matters.
